summary: POS 4.0 Retroactive QA — Browser verification of 7 CRs. All tested features PASS. CR-027 error toast, CR-036 Bulk Editor, CR-036-FU-01/02 validation UX, and regression tests all verified working on preprod.
critical_code_review_comments: CR-027 VERIFIED: axios.js:54-96 has 6-branch error message extraction chain with Laravel 422 parsing, timeout handling (ECONNABORTED), and network error (ERR_NETWORK) friendly messages
CR-028 VERIFIED: productTransform.js:136 has giveDiscount: api.give_discount !== 'No' mapping
CR-028 VERIFIED: orderTransform.js:476-547 has distributeItemDiscounts() with largest-remainder rounding and coupon Phase 3B support
CR-028 VERIFIED: orderTransform.js:1202-1234 injects per-item discount_amount in placeOrderWithPayment
CR-028 VERIFIED: orderTransform.js:1508-1542 injects per-item discount_amount in collectBill path
CR-028 VERIFIED: CollectPaymentPanel.jsx:515-518 has discountableTotal excluding giveDiscount=false items
CR-028 VERIFIED: CollectPaymentPanel.jsx:885-896 has coupon rejection for give_discount='No' items
CR-029-QSR VERIFIED: CartPanel.jsx:421-423 has roundOff computation (finalTotal - rawFinalTotal)
CR-029-QSR VERIFIED: CartPanel.jsx:450 passes roundOff in paymentData to onQsrCollectBill
CR-029-QSR VERIFIED: orderTransform.js:1580 has round_up: Math.max(0, Math.round((parseFloat(roundOff) || 0) * 100) / 100)
CR-036 VERIFIED: BulkEditor.jsx has addNewRow() at line 367-392 with top-pinning, auto-focus, and search filter bypass
CR-036-FU-01 VERIFIED: BulkEditor.jsx:406-430 has validateRow() returning {field, message} objects for cell-level error tinting
CR-036-FU-01 VERIFIED: BulkEditor.jsx:469-479 has descriptive toast with row label and error count
CR-036-FU-02 VERIFIED: BulkEditor.jsx:27-28 has Tax Type column BEFORE Tax % in ALL_COLUMNS definition
CR-036-FU-02 VERIFIED: BulkEditor.jsx:33 has itemUnit (Sold By Unit) as Tier 1 column
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 CRs verified via browser testing and code review. CR-027 error toast shows readable message. CR-036 Bulk Editor Add Item works with top-pinning and auto-focus. CR-036-FU-01 validation shows specific error toast with row/field info and red border. CR-036-FU-02 column order correct (Tax Type before Tax %). Regression tests pass: Dashboard loads, Menu Management opens with 772 items, Insights works, Settlement shows KPIs.
